The '''union protesters''' are a group of characters who appear in the first episode of the second season of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

The union protesters are portrayed by various uncredited background actors and stunt performers. Only one non-stunt actor in the scene, [[Angel Manuel]], is credited, for the role of the [[protest foreperson]].
